steps.content: Everything stops. Corso looks around the ruin shrouded in smoke, and besides her so-called companion, there's no more living prey she can fiddle with.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: You scared away my hard-won toys... What am I supposed to do now?
Her question is ignored. Nightmare struggles a bit as it lifts Matilda who has slumped to the ground. The battle wasn't tough, but the faint black spikes appearing on Hecate's body are burdening her.

Ever since ${PlayerName} disappeared in March, the shackles have been backfired by the Mania of Corpus 002. Every time she uses her power, it results in severe contamination. Hecate doesn't care though. She prefers to believe that the shackles' presence proves that Chief is still alive.
But that doesn't cheer her up at all. The girl now wears a gloomy face, turning around to leave with her captive.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: The mission's objective is achieved. Let's return immediately. Once the Executive Committee's reinforcements arrive, it'll waste more of our time.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Will they send reinforcements? If so, I'd rather stay. I haven't had a good fight in a while and I'm itching for one.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Why are you glaring at me? If you wanna take their place, that's fine too. It'll help me blow off some steam.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Hahaha, just joking. I have no interest in hassling someone who’s frail like you.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: When the day comes that your Chief dies and the shackles break, you'll be able to fight with all your strength. I'll come looking for you then.
Corso reaches out to ruffle the young girl's hair, but Hecate swats her hand away. Her cloak loosens a bit, revealing her furious eyes.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...I can kill you right now, you Rustfire scum.
As if seizing that brief moment, a metallic sphere suddenly shoots out of the rubble with a clamor. The camera flashes as it quickly flees the site.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Oh, it's the Executive Committee's security camera! Did it capture our heroic deeds just now?
Hecate anxiously tries to chase after it, but Nightmare hasn't recovered enough to make precise quick attacks. And at that very moment...
Bang! A gunshot, and the flitting security camera is immediately hit, exploding into a tiny firework.
The one firing the shot is Matilda. She was just thrown on the ground by Nightmare and has somehow grabbed a gun and fired that bullseye shot.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Whoosh... What a shot! Next time you should join me for some fun, ey? Miss Carabanda?

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: My last name is Cavendish. When we get back to the base, I can train with you. But you must promise not to provoke your teammates or cause trouble during missions anymore.
She dusts herself off and stands up, then lifts her hand to help Hecate pull on her hood, covering the girl's too-pale face.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: You shouldn't have come, Hecate. I can handle Corso, and the MBCC can't know about your collaboration with Rustfire.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...If they found out, I'd just say I was attacking a traitor of the Executive Committee.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: This isn't a collaboration either.
Matilda's hand is also pushed away.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Where is Chief? Any news?

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: That's a question for a safer place.
Hecate glares at her. Corso whistles, and Matilda says nothing more. She sets up the scene, staging an attack against the patrol.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: All right, I've faked an attack scene here. This way, the Executive Committee won't suspect anything. They already have their hands full.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Thanks for coming to get me. Now, let's return to the base.

The three pry open a manhole cover on the road and jump in. An elderly man has been waiting for a long time in the dried-up tunnel. He raises a blue lantern and leads the three deeper into the darkness.

After several hours of meandering, the three Sinners finally arrive at an underground hideout in the contaminated area. The old man nods and leaves. A red-haired middle-aged woman opens the secret door to welcome them.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: ...Good thing you've arrived safe and sound. Come on in.

<size=40>Matilda Cavendish became a Sinner in N.F. 112 due to an accident during her duty.

The Cavendish family is unable to stomach this kind of scandal, so she must keep it a secret.

She was therefore threatened by someone who knew her secret and became a Rustfire collaborator.</size>
At first, she was indeed forced to cooperate to protect the honor of the Cavendish family. But after the uprising broke out and Matilda decided to stay in West District, her thoughts have changed.
<size=40>Looking back, she might have been longing for an answer, one she couldn't find in the East.</size>
